scope: EK08/EK01 partial: validate staged CPU/HF MP4 before publishing, not human/native/editorial acceptance
behavior: Reuse one staged-output validator for CPU and HF: finite positive dimensions/duration, actual video/audio codecs, expected full-size dimensions or preview aspect ratio, expected duration and full decode of primary video/audio streams.

CPU validates before immutable manifest and atomic replace, and returns the already validated staged metadata instead of probing the target after replacement. Input/resolved-media/target CAS runs after encode and after validation/publication preparation.

HF keeps its post-normalization validation and failed-stage decode/error logs through the shared function. Existing .1s duration and .005 preview-ratio tolerances remain unchanged. Human/native states are never promoted by decode.

tests.regression_before_fix: The new CPU invalid-output test failed on eleven simulated bad metadata/probe/decode/timeout cases before the fix; no validation error was raised.
cases: CPU thirteen invalid-output cases plus valid/wrong-ratio preview and source/style/target changes during decode preserve the prior output.
Real FFmpeg valid primary streams pass without changing bytes; missing audio/video, wrong size/duration and a truncated faststart MP4 whose metadata remains valid are refused.
HF missing-video fixture now represents its codec explicitly; real normalization/probe/decode and preservation regressions pass.
tests.smoke_retry: First smoke ran concurrently with imports and encountered WinError5 on a .pyc rename. That run completed with1failure. After other test processes terminated, serialized smoke passed all28; no source compiler check was removed or relaxed.

actual_editor_playwright.fixture: Isolated real editor/router and generated8s9:16 source plus generated tone music/SFX; no customer or paid media.

failure.method: Fixture truncates the real CPU encoded MP4 after FFmpeg exits0; shared probe/decode and API handler remain real.
failure.reason: Full decode found a corrupt input packet in the audio stream. Container metadata still reports8s1080x1920 with audio and video.

actual_editor_playwright.routes: CPU final/preview are exercised through Playwright HTTP requests to the actual API; HF is exercised through the real Export button. CPU full and HF are1080x1920; CPU preview540x960; each is8s and records full_av_decode passed.
actual_editor_playwright.timing_scope: CPU response encode_seconds excludes validation/setup/failure/review; HF22.4s is one generated export. No timing baseline, approval duration or savings claim.
actual_editor_playwright.artifact_storage: The fixture retained its intentionally truncated MP4 for inspection. Production CPU temporary-stage cleanup is unchanged; HF retains its failure stages/logs.

current_ci: New source/evidence requires exact-head CI after push.
limits: Primary-stream decode and metadata agreement do not prove spoken-word sync, translation meaning, complete stories, visual quality or human approval.
Native open/save/reopen/playback, team-manifest approval binding, full runtime/global-option/environment coverage, a watched real pilot and full timing/installer/hardware gates remain open.

This slice does not implement the complete error/warning/pending quality dashboard or guarantee repair previews for every legacy overflow/clock error; audit those plan requirements before treating EK08 as complete.
Full EK01-EK12 goal remains active; no batch, release, merge or stability/savings claim.
privacy: Only sanitized states, hashes, codec/dimension metadata and controlled corruption sizes are public. Private manifests, paths, CLI/server logs and generated artifacts stay local.
